s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of purpuric lesions with systemic involvement and multi-organ dysfunction
salient_findings: Purpuric lesions on face, elbows, knees, and feet
Skin sloughing off lesions on elbows and knees
Reticulated purpuric macules and patches on extensor surfaces
Dusky purpuric macules and patches on nose, cheeks, forehead, and ear
key_facts: Patient has a history of nonischemic cardiomyopathy
Patient has chronic kidney disease
Patient presented with altered mental status after an unwitnessed fall
New lesions developed on nose, ear, and extensor surfaces of arms
Hypercalcemia with calcium level of 11.5 mg/dL
Acute kidney injury with creatinine level of 5.6 mg/dL
Rouleaux and cryoprotein precipitate on peripheral blood smear
Abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses
Monoclonal IgG-κ protein on immunofixation electrophoresis
Elevated serum cryoglobulin levels with cryocrit of 16%
Biopsy showed intravascular fibrinoid material with cryoglobulins and fibrin thrombi
CT scan of pelvis revealed lytic bony lesions
Bone marrow biopsy showed hypercellular marrow with 80% plasma cells and κ-light-chain restriction

shortlist.label: Multiple myeloma
shortlist.why_kept: Hypercalcemia, lytic bony lesions, and bone marrow biopsy showing hypercellular marrow with 80% plasma cells

shortlist.label: Cryoglobulinemia
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated serum cryoglobulin levels, cryoprotein precipitate on peripheral blood smear, and biopsy showing intravascular fibrinoid material with cryoglobulins and fibrin thrombi

shortlist.label: Monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance
shortlist.why_kept: Abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses and monoclonal IgG-κ protein on immunofixation electrophoresis

shortlist.label: Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia
shortlist.why_kept: Monoclonal IgG-κ protein and elevated serum cryoglobulin levels

shortlist.label: Mixed cryoglobulinemia
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated serum cryoglobulin levels and presence of purpuric lesions with systemic involvement

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms and laboratory results, including the presence of cryoprotein precipitate on peripheral blood smear, elevated serum cryoglobulin levels, and biopsy findings of intravascular fibrinoid material with cryoglobulins and fibrin thrombi, are consistent with cryoglobulinemia.

rejected.label: Multiple myeloma
rejected.why: While the patient has hypercalcemia and lytic bony lesions, which can be seen in multiple myeloma, the presence of cryoglobulins and the specific biopsy findings point more towards cryoglobulinemia.

rejected.label: Monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory results are more consistent with a specific disease entity, such as cryoglobulinemia, rather than a condition of undetermined significance.

rejected.label: Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia
rejected.why: The patient's laboratory results do not show a high level of IgM monoclonal protein, which is characteristic of Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia.

rejected.label: Mixed cryoglobulinemia
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory results are consistent with cryoglobulinemia, but the specific type (mixed) is not clearly supported by the provided information.
